# WO-175: Facebook/Instagram post template set
Status: open (design; Nora dispatches, WIP 5)
Vendor: codex
Agent: designer (Canva)
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_CODEX.md)
Assigned to: Codex designer named by Nora
Source: docs/design/CANVA_BRIEFS.md CB-01, requested by Jordan Ellis (brand-marketing); reviewer: in-house graphic-designer

## Goal
Four post templates (wrong place, scope, keeps checking, download), each at 1080x1080 and 1080x1350. Full brief, exact copy, sizes, alt text and shared colour/type specs: docs/design/CANVA_BRIEFS.md "CB-01" and its shared section. Where this WO's notes differ from the brief, this WO wins.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Sizes and formats exactly as the brief; one export per size.
- On-image copy word for word from the brief (or from the override below); no other words.
- Colours and type per docs/BRAND.md and the brief; the logo only from brand/logo/final, unaltered.
- Text contrast at least 4.5:1; readable on a phone.
- No real personal data (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL if a name is needed), no photos of real identifiable people, no broker logos.
- One row per file in brand/codex/MANIFEST.md: file, WO, Canva design link, Canva stock elements used (or "none"), alt text.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- brand/codex/WO-175/ (new files only)
- brand/codex/MANIFEST.md (append your rows)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
brand/ outside brand/codex/, web/, src/, every other file. No GitHub commits or PRs; status goes on the WO-175 issue as a comment.

## Check-in plan
VENDOR_STATUS.md and a comment on the WO-175 issue in FreeMyID/freemyid-pm. The graphic-designer reviews; Jordan schedules social use.
